description: Baseline CI test-suite registry. Every suite declares how an empty match set is handled so that a silently empty suite can never report success.

vitest.emptyExitCodeReason: Vitest is never invoked with an empty match set; the runner resolves files first.

pytest.emptyExitCodeReason: Pytest exit code 5 means no tests were collected and is treated as an empty suite, never as success.

suites.description: Frontend toolchain, DOM, and accessibility smoke tests.
Release-manifest policy and CI registry tests.
Read-only migration inventory and repository safety tests.
Catalog, evaluator, conservation, and visualization-plan tests.
Strict API contract, inverse solver, and tutor-scope tests.
suites.emptyReason: Reserved for the versioned FastAPI contracts delivered by tasks 11 to 16; the directory is intentionally empty until then and the suite is reported as declared-empty rather than passing.
